data.name: Dodi
data.gender_notes: Dodi is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word ‘dod’, meaning ‘beloved’. In the Bible, Dodi is a name given to a man who was deeply in love with Ruth. Their love story is a beautiful example of loyalty and faithfulness in relationships. The name Dodi carries the meaning “Beloved” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew. Parents who choose Dodi usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of deep love and devotion.
data.etymology: Dodi belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dodi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: דודי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דוֹדִי הוא שם כבוד המשמר את מורשת האהבה והקרבה בין האדם לאלוהים, ובין האדם לאחיו. השם דודי נזכר בספר שמואל, ובו הוא שם כבוד למלך ישראל. במסורת היהודית, דודי הוא שם שמסמל את האהבה והקרבה לאלוהים, ובעקבות זאת, השם דודי הפך לשם נפוץ בקרב יהודי המערב, ואף נזכר בספרי השנה העברית, ובספרי השנה העברית עבור ילד.

in_greek.name: Δόδι
in_greek.long_meaning: Δόδι (Δόδι) είναι όνομα που συνδέεται με την αγάπη και την προσοχή. Στον Ιουδαϊσμό, ο Δόδι είναι ο τίτλος του βασιλιά Δαυίδ και συνδέεται με την αλήθεια και την ευθύνη. Στον Χριστιανισμό, ο όρος Δόδι αναφέρεται στην αγάπη και την κοινωνία.

in_latin.name: Dodi
in_latin.long_meaning: Dodi est nomen pietatis et caritatis, quae in libro Psalterii mentio fit. In Ecclesia Veteris Testamenti, Dodi est nomen regis David, qui est exemplar fidelitatis et caritatis. In Ecclesia Novi Testamenti, Dodi est nomen amoris et caritatis, quae Christus promovit. Hoc nomen est in usu apud Christianos, qui caritatem et pietatem colunt.

in_english.name: Dodi
in_english.meaning: love, affection, closeness, beloved, dear one

This name is used by Christians who value love and charity, and it is often given to children born into loving families.
